szoveg_eredeti:
We launched a new child safety classifier, available for free to vetted organizations, to help more platforms detect child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and reduce the burden on human reviewers.

In our testing, the classifier flagged roughly 50% fewer images for review while identifying approximately the same amount of abusive content, helping safety teams identify and act on harmful content more efficiently.

By making this technology available to other organizations, we hope to extend its impact beyond our own platforms and help strengthen child safety across the industry.

We’re grateful to early partners including fal , invideo , SafetyKit and more whose testing has helped demonstrate the potential of this technology.

Protecting children online requires collective action. The more organizations equipped to detect and stop abuse, the safer we can make the internet for children.
